required_documents.name: SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance
required_documents.details: Standard grant cover application submitted via Grants.gov.

required_documents.name: 36-Month Tribal Dementia Capability Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Comprehensive project narrative detailing plan to implement dementia-capable HCBS systems in Indian Country under Option A (expansion of prior ADPI program) or Option B (new to ADPI program).

required_documents.name: Tribal Leadership Resolution or Authorized Official Documentation
required_documents.details: Formal resolution or authorization letter from tribal leadership demonstrating authority to conduct proposed activities.

required_documents.name: SF-424A Budget Information and 36-Month Narrative
required_documents.details: Budget requesting up to ,000 total federal share over 36 months for tribal elder dementia services.

required_documents.name: Tribal Elder and Community Caregiver Engagement Plan
required_documents.details: Culturally responsive plan for supporting tribal elders with dementia and their family caregivers.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov Active UEI Registration
required_documents.details: Active Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) on SAM.gov.

eligibility.summary: Federally recognized Indian Tribes, tribal organizations, and consortiums representing federally recognized tribes actively providing home and community services in tribal communities. Foreign entities ineligible.

cost_share.details: Non-federal cost match is not required or can be waived for tribal governments under ACL policy.

review_criteria.criterion: Demonstrated Tribal Leadership Support and Community Need
Cultural Appropriateness of Person-Centered Dementia HCBS Services
Sustainability and Integration with Existing Tribal Health and Elder Programs

funded_activities.activity: Implementing person-centered, strengths-based dementia home and community-based services (HCBS) in tribal communities.
Providing supportive services, respite, and culturally adapted educational resources for tribal elder caregivers.
Building tribal healthcare and community health worker capacity for early dementia identification.

submission_limits: Eligible entities may apply under Option A (expansion) or Option B (new), but not both.
important_notes: 36-month cooperative agreements with award ceiling of ,000.
Applications must include tribal leadership resolution demonstrating authority.
